---
name: Bug report
about: Something in the emulator or its tools does not behave as documented
---

> **Do not attach firmware.** No `*.UPD`/`*.LDR` files, flash dumps, unpacked
> images or disassembly. Give the firmware's version string and SHA-256 instead.
> Security problems: report privately, see SECURITY.md.

**What you ran** (full command line, profile: CDJ-2000 or NXS)

**What you expected**

**What happened** (paste the relevant part of the run report or log)

**Environment** (OS, Python version, QEMU version, how you built the boards)
